verdict.rationale: Datadog's core docs cover agent-based instrumentation for hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud integrations, plus APM, database monitoring, Kubernetes autoscaling, and OpenTelemetry support — the standard vendor-maintained instrumentation surface for SRE telemetry. Community evidence corroborates ease of collecting metrics/traces/logs across environments in practice. Missing for 10: explicit per-cloud-integration docs (AWS/GCP/Azure specifics) and independent benchmarks on agent coverage breadth beyond community anecdotes.
